characters.name: Adam Neumann
characters.description: Co-founder and former CEO of WeWork, known for his charismatic yet controversial leadership style.
characters.visual_description: A tall man with long hair, often seen in casual yet stylish attire, exuding confidence and energy, frequently gesturing animatedly during presentations.

characters.name: Miguel McKelvey
characters.description: Co-founder of WeWork, focused on the company's design and community aspects.
characters.visual_description: A well-groomed man with a thoughtful demeanor, often dressed in smart casual clothing, seen engaging with employees and clients in WeWork spaces.

locations.name: WeWork Headquarters
locations.description: The original headquarters of WeWork located in New York City, a vibrant space filled with modern design elements and collaborative work areas.
locations.visual_description: An open-concept office with colorful furniture, communal tables, and artistic decor, bustling with diverse professionals working together.

locations.name: WeWork Locations Worldwide
locations.description: Various WeWork coworking spaces around the globe, each designed to foster community and collaboration.
locations.visual_description: Stylish and contemporary office spaces featuring glass walls, lounge areas, and meeting rooms, often filled with people networking and working.

important_objects.name: S-1 Filing Document
important_objects.description: The official document filed by WeWork in April 2019 to initiate its IPO process.
important_objects.visual_description: A thick stack of papers with a bold 'S-1' label on the cover, symbolizing the company's ambitious plans to go public.

important_objects.name: SoftBank Investment
important_objects.description: The significant financial backing from SoftBank that propelled WeWork's growth.
important_objects.visual_description: A large check or digital representation of funds being transferred, symbolizing the massive investment that fueled WeWork's expansion.

timeline_periods.name: 2010-2014: The Founding and Early Growth
timeline_periods.description: The period when WeWork was founded and began to establish itself in the coworking market.
timeline_periods.visual_description: Images of early WeWork spaces, enthusiastic team meetings, and initial investor pitches.

timeline_periods.name: 2017-2019: Rapid Expansion and IPO Plans
timeline_periods.description: The phase of aggressive growth, significant investments, and the lead-up to the IPO filing.
timeline_periods.visual_description: Footage of bustling WeWork locations, investor meetings, and the excitement surrounding the IPO roadshow.

timeline_periods.name: 2019: The Downfall
timeline_periods.description: The tumultuous year when WeWork's IPO was postponed and valuation plummeted.
timeline_periods.visual_description: Dramatic visuals of news headlines, investor reactions, and the aftermath of Neumann's departure.
